events.verdict: Richardson (MIA) places a hand/arm to the front of Durant (GSW) during the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Cousins (GSW) briefly grasps Adebayo's (MIA) arm prior to the pick but it does not affect his FOM.
Cousins (GSW) grasps Adebayo's (MIA) arm during the rebound affecting his ability to gather the ball.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Durant (GSW) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes legal position in Durant's (GSW) path and makes some contact during the pick but he is able to defend through the play.
Green (GSW) slightly extends his hand into Adebayo's (MIA) shoulder but the contact is not enough to knock him off of his path when going to set the screen.
Cousins (GSW) makes contact with Adebayo's (MIA) arms off ball that does not affect his ability to get to the pass.
Durant (GSW) makes contact to the arm of Winslow (MIA) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Richardson (MIA) places a hand/arm to the front of Durant (GSW) during the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Richardson (MIA) cleanly dislodges the pass and as he goes for the loose ball. Richardson makes marginal contact with Curry's (GSW) arm but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Thompson (GSW) briefly grasps Winslow's (MIA) sides during the screen but he is able to move through contact.
Cousins (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Richardson (MIA) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Green (GSW) briefly clamps the arm of Winslow (MIA) during the screen but does not affect his ability to maintain his defensive position as the two defensive players switch.
Green (GSW) briefly grasps Adebayo's (MIA) arm prior to the pick but it does not affect his FOM.
Curry (GSW) engages with Richardson (MIA) and briefly grasps him prior to the screen but it does not affect his FOM.
Richardson (MIA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Thompson (GSW) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Durant (GSW) makes some contact with Adebayo (MIA) during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Combining video evidence from multiple angles confirms that the ball does not make contact with Winslow's (MIA) foot/shin and a discontinued dribble should have been called on Durant (GSW).
Cousins (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Winslow (MIA) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contest Durant's (GSW) jump shot and Durant (GSW) makes foot contact with Adebayo (MIA) as he lands but he is able to move through the contact.
Winslow (MIA) makes contact to the arm of Cousins (GSW) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Livingston (GSW) puts a hand to the front of Wade (GSW) and briefly places his opposite hand around his back and removes it without affecting his FOM.
During the off ball screen Durant (GSW) puts his arm to the front of Adebayo's (MIA) chest and briefly slides his arm across his back without affecting his FOM.

Based on L-Slash, Thompson (GSW) does not appear to extend his leg unnaturally and there is no conclusive angle that shows foot contact while trailing Richardson (MIA). From broadcast, it appears that Richardson may trip over Adebayo's (MIA) foot as he comes off the screen.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Durant (GSW) and absorbs the contact.
Adebayo (MIA) makes some contact with Durant (GSW) during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
